home.newsletterTitle: A calmer way to follow the world
home.newsletterBody: One quiet briefing. No noise, no clickbait.

search.noResultsBody: We couldn't find anything matching your search. Try another country, topic, or keyword.

pages.aboutBody1: Pressly is a global news and intelligence service. Our brief is to design the experience of understanding the world — not the experience of browsing a website.
pages.aboutBody2: We publish in English, Arabic, French and German. The interface follows the language you choose; each story stays in the language it was reported in.
pages.editorialBody1: Every story carries a named author and passes through review and copy-editing before it is published. Nothing reaches the Reader without an editor releasing it.
pages.editorialBody2: Analysis is labelled as analysis. Photography is credited to the photographer, with its licence recorded alongside it.
pages.contactBody1: For newsroom enquiries, story tips and corrections, write to the editorial desk.
pages.contactBody2: If you are reporting an error, tell us the headline and what is wrong, and we will look into it.
